summary: AKT ~$0.68 (+5.3% 24h). Akash governance Proposal 346 to migrate the network to Solana has ~98% yes on 34.7m AKT, past quorum, voting open until 2 Nov; AKT would convert 1:1 to a Solana token after audits. Founder Greg Osuri pushing the vote. Bullish on lower costs/access, but migration execution risk remains.
